name: bizplug-plumbing
description: The plumbing plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: estimate and book a plumber. It works from the business's own published profile, covering emergency service, pricing and job requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Estimate and book a plumber for plumbing businesses.

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.
Calls get_service_estimate and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: Do you offer emergency service, and what's the call-out fee?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls request_plumber_visit only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.
